clone_flags.why: history, LFS payloads, datasets and submodules are not needed to pin and call the code, and each would cost tens of GB

working_tree.correction: this field previously read `dirty: 0`, which was false. Installing the runtime regenerated tracked .egg-info metadata and `vesuvius.accept_terms` wrote agreement.txt INTO the checkout. HEAD never moved, so a HEAD-only check reported a match while the working tree no longer equalled the pinned commit. The counts are now split: generated install metadata does not revoke the pin, a modified source file does.

what_each_count_means.dirty_generated_count: install side-effects (egg-info, agreement.txt, pycache); expected, does not revoke the pin
what_each_count_means.dirty_source_count: files that change what Villa executes; MUST be 0 for is_the_pinned_code

runtime.rule: Villa gets its OWN runtime from its own lockfile, invoked through a subprocess adapter. An existing Python environment is NOT modified -- contaminating a working environment to reach a new one is how both stop working.
runtime.why_separate_is_mandatory_not_preferred: Villa's current packages declare requires-python >=3.14,<3.15. An older Python environment cannot install it, so Villa runs in its own runtime.
runtime.install_method: editable from the pinned checkout, so the code executed IS the pinned commit rather than a copy that can drift invisibly. Safe only because the adapter re-verifies HEAD against this lock before every run.

cache.policy: referenced IN PLACE, never copied or redownloaded to tidy the layout; walking a large cache with du is itself expensive and is avoided.

torch_band_finding.consequence: on Python 3.14 NO torch satisfies both components, so vesuvius and spiral-fitting CANNOT share one runtime. A spiral-fitting run therefore needs its own environment built from spiral-fitting/uv.lock, not this one.

cpp_gate.build: scikit-build-core + nanobind + CMake, resolved by RELATIVE PATH inside the monorepo
cpp_gate.note: vesuvius.predict RUNS without it. The native path is intended for a Linux GPU host.
